facts.text: Sleepyhead’s official FAQ describes it as an Indian brand.

guardian.requirements.text: Use authentic Sleepyhead logo artwork and appropriate supplied variant; preserve its proportions, colours, contrast and clear space. Do not rotate, distort, recolour, bevel, emboss or add a drop shadow. No production logo artwork is present in the supplied materials.

The excerpts specify orange #F15A22 and charcoal #414042. The white specification conflicts: RGB indicates #FFFFFF, while the printed hex is #231F20. Treat white as unresolved; do not use #231F20 as white.
The excerpts name Migrena Grotesque for brand typography and Source Sans Pro for web typography. Font availability and licensing are unconfirmed; do not claim exact rendering unless verified.
Keep selected colours, patterns and mixed design elements cohesive; the excerpts call for bold colour, playful patterns and asymmetry.

guardian.preferences.text: Supplied excerpts describe a human-centred, young/vibrant, quirky and playful Jester identity focused on connection and enjoyment. This is supplied positioning, not proof of audience response.
Favor humorous, informal, creative and personable language; keep it useful and clear, and avoid unsupported product promises.

As advisory inspiration, consider the whole domestic space—architecture, circulation, colour relationships, daylight, furniture grouping and lived-in activity. Expressive, patterned rooms and quieter alternatives are both represented; no single room formula is required.
The official site currently presents a broad home-comfort range and uses the lowercase Sleepyhead wordmark with orange accents. This is an observation, not a mandatory campaign template.

guardian.visualRules.value: Use the supplied brand orange #F15A22 as a specified brand colour.
Use the supplied charcoal #414042 as a specified brand colour.

Preserve authentic logo artwork, proportions and clear space; do not rotate, distort, recolour, bevel, emboss or add a drop shadow. Prefer the master mark for general communication and use an appropriate authentic variant.
The supplied excerpts specify Migrena Grotesque for brand typography and Source Sans Pro for web typography. Exact font rendering is subject to availability and verification.
Keep selected playful colours, patterns and mixed styles tied together by a coherent palette or design theme; the supplied excerpts also call for asymmetry.

brandResearch.findings.title: Sleep and home-comfort range
brandResearch.findings.text: Sleepyhead’s official site presents a broad home-comfort range including mattresses, beds, sofas, sofa beds, recliners, pillows and other home furnishings. The site describes the brand as Indian.

brandResearch.findings.title: Supplied identity guidance
brandResearch.findings.text: The supplied Sleepyhead guideline excerpts describe a human-centred, young/vibrant, quirky and fabulous identity, with a Jester archetype focused on connection and enjoyment. The excerpts are partial; their original version and approval status are not established.

brandResearch.findings.title: Colour, typography and mark
brandResearch.findings.text: Guideline excerpts specify orange #F15A22 and charcoal #414042, and name Migrena Grotesque for brand typography and Source Sans Pro for web typography. The supplied white specification conflicts: RGB 255,255,255 implies #FFFFFF, while the printed hex is #231F20; treat #FFFFFF as an interpretation pending correction. The guide describes a lowercase wordmark and closed-eye “ee” motif; no production logo artwork or Migrena Grotesque font files are supplied.

brandResearch.findings.title: Conversational, playful voice
brandResearch.findings.text: Supplied voice guidance favours humorous, informal, creative and personable language, including wit and wordplay, while remaining useful and clear and avoiding unsupported product promises.

brandResearch.findings.title: Whole-room inspiration, not a fixed template
brandResearch.findings.text: The client-selected spatial board is advisory inspiration, not a mandatory brand rule or Sleepyhead product evidence. Its supplied research describes expressive domestic spaces using colour, pattern, rounded forms, daylight and lived-in activity, alongside quieter alternatives. The bounded image subset includes a peach sectional in a bright room and an open-plan room with architectural colour zoning; these are references, not exact Sleepyhead products.
